lines.t: I’m sitting in the quiet of the wreckage
Collecting every fragment on the floor
I thought the silence was a final sentence
A heavy lock upon a broken door
But in the hollow, I can hear a heartbeat
A steady rhythm calling out my name
You don’t look away from the mess I’ve made
You’re stepping through the shadows and the shade
You find the beauty in the ruins
You see the temple in the dust
Where I saw a wasteland, You saw a kingdom
A place where I can learn to trust
Out of the ashes, You’re building something new
Only You can make the ruins beautiful
It’s not a project, it’s a restoration
Every crack is where the light gets in
You take the pieces of my reputation
And wash away the sorrow and the sin
I’ll leave the hammer in Your steady hands
The Architect who finally understands
You find the beauty in the ruins
You see the temple in the dust
Where I saw a wasteland, You saw a kingdom
A place where I can learn to trust
Out of the ashes, You’re building something new
Only You can make the ruins beautiful
It’s not a graveyard, it’s a garden
It’s not an ending, it’s a start
You’re writing mercy on the ruins
Of my broken heart...
Beautiful...
Only You...
[End]
